stories.headline: Yardeni Cuts S&P 500 Target After Stock Selloff
stories.what_happened: Wall Street strategist Ed Yardeni cut his S&P 500 Index year-end forecast for the second time in about two months in the wake of a powerful stock selloff that pushed the benchmark into a technical correction. The president and chief investment strategist of Yardeni Research Inc. sees the index closing out 2026 at 7,500 points, down from the reduced target of 7,900 he projected in September. That would still represent a recovery of more than 8% for US stocks from where they ended on Friday. For details, Bloomberg's Nathan Hager speaks with Ed Yardeni of Yardeni Research. (Source: Bloomberg)

stories.headline: GPT-6.2 Astra solved a math theorem no other AI could crack, then invented its own proof strategy
stories.what_happened: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra independently produced a machine-verifiable Lean proof of Smoktunowicz's gap theorem, the first of its kind according to Vals AI. The model chose its own approach because key foundations were missing from Mathlib. On Autoform-Hard, Astra now leads the leaderboard with 49 of 56 tasks solved.
